text: {"assertions":["A missing step issue was found in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py on 2026-05-10.","The missing step issue only affected accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The root cause was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The issue was detected by a stage with zero users appearing between two populated stages.","The fix involved adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches.","The fix is documented in PR #3637 on branch fix/missing-step-1.","The funnel job performance improved from 2 hours to 14 minutes after applying the fix.","This missing step problem occurred in the same section of analytics/dashboards/funnel.py as previous missing step work."]}
